data.content:
Implemented the `simple-git` v3 upgrade. Both root and proxy-server manifests now use `^3.0.0`, and `yarn.lock` resolves it to `3.36.0` since an exact `3.0.0` package is not published.

Updated the local git middleware to import from `simple-git` instead of the deprecated `simple-git/promise` entrypoint and switched type references to the exported `SimpleGit` type. The proxy-server Jest config now aliases legacy `simple-git/promise` test imports to the v3 module so existing tests keep exercising the upgraded dependency.
